Due to the weight of this item, it will require assistance with unloading & moving at point of delivery.

Compact and manoeuvrable double-bevel sliding mitre saw with a robust 1500W motor and LED shadow line technology. Features quick-release mitre lock handle for accurate mitre adjustments and a cam-lock that delivers a secure and stable platform for larger projects. Carry handle ensures easy transportation between jobs, while cable storage at rear of saw guarantees that the power cord is stored neatly and safely. Includes an integrated measurement scale on the fence and a dust chute plate for the minimalization of dust and debris. Supplied with an inner blade guard for faster start-ups. Ideal for working on hardwoods and dense materials, achieving clean, precise cuts every time.
